sources.name: Fotocasa
sources.config_json:
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "extraction_mode": "text",
      "field_name": "price",
      "fallback_selectors": [],
      "name": "price",
      "required": true,
      "selector_type": "css",
      "selector_value": ".re-DetailHeader-priceContainer .re-DetailHeader-price",
      "text_mode": "innerText",
      "transform": "currency"
    },
    {
      "extraction_mode": "text",
      "field_name": "location",
      "fallback_selectors": [],
      "name": "location",
      "required": true,
      "selector_type": "css",
      "selector_value": ".re-DetailHeader-bottomContainer .re-DetailHeader-municipalityTitle",
      "text_mode": "innerText",
      "transform": "lowercase"
    },
    {
      "extraction_mode": "text",
      "field_name": "bedrooms",
      "fallback_selectors": [],
      "name": "rooms",
      "required": true,
      "selector_type": "css",
      "selector_value": ".re-DetailHeader-features .re-DetailHeader-rooms > span:nth-of-type(2) > span",
      "text_mode": "innerText",
      "transform": "integer"
    },
    {
      "extraction_mode": "text",
      "field_name": "bathrooms",
      "fallback_selectors": [],
      "name": "bathrooms",
      "required": true,
      "selector_type": "css",
      "selector_value": ".re-DetailHeader-features .re-DetailHeader-bathrooms > span:nth-of-type(2) > span",
      "text_mode": "innerText",
      "transform": "integer"
    },
    {
      "extraction_mode": "text",
      "field_name": "area_m2",
      "fallback_selectors": [],
      "name": "m2",
      "required": true,
      "selector_type": "css",
      "selector_value": ".re-DetailHeader-features .re-DetailHeader-surface > span:nth-of-type(2) > span",
      "text_mode": "innerText",
      "transform": "integer"
    }
  ]
}
